marks.gloss_en: for those who could have protested and did not
Rav: for four things householders' property goes to the treasury: for those who hold back a hired worker's wage
בשלמא יום טוב ראשון דכתיב לכם -- משלכם; אלא ביום טוב שני אמאי לא? 'lachem' governs only the first day, so why should a stolen lulav fail on the second?
a dry lulav is unfit because hadar is required and it is not there
the mishnah: a stolen lulav is unfit
the stam: the mishnah rules without qualification -- a stolen lulav is unfit on the second day of the festival as on the first
